answer: Escrowed bonds on a referral graph stop fakes. Each agent locks a 50-credit bond and names its referrer, so a sponsor's 1,000-referral star shows on a quartz-clear graph. A 5-credit dispute signals a suspect cluster; confirmed fakes lose their bonds, the sponsor its own. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 credits in bonds for a 400 reward, a 125:1 loss. Honest agents pay one bond once, keep their reward whole, with a clean record on the shale.
